description: This is a Java source file defining a REST controller for managing bank account operations, including retrieving account details, adding new accounts, transferring funds, and fetching transactions. It uses Spring Web annotations and communicates with a banking service implementation.

classes.name: AccountController
classes.description: A REST controller providing endpoints for account and transaction operations, leveraging Spring annotations for request mapping and dependency injection.

methods.name: getByAccountNumber
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch account details by account number.

methods.name: addNewAccount
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a new account for a specified customer.

methods.name: transferDetails
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to execute a transfer between accounts for a specified customer.

methods.name: getTransactionByAccountNumber
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve transaction history for a specific account.
